job: Hide text from sight but keep it for screen readers, or add a small motion.
purpose: Four helpers: fd-sr-only hides content visually and keeps it for assistive technology; fd-fade and fd-rise play a short entrance (reduced-motion safe); fd-cq makes an element a container for container queries.
useWhen: A control or heading needs a name that sighted users read from context (fd-sr-only).
Content that loads in should fade or rise into place (fd-fade, fd-rise).

avoidWhen.when: A tooltip should show a label to everyone.
A visible hidden-until-needed region is needed.
An icon button needs a name.

parts.role: Visually hidden, read by screen readers.
Rises into place while fading in.
Makes the element a size container.
